How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR System Administrator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JNCASR System Administrator position is 06-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the System Administrator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree in CSE, ECE, EEE, or IT. Additionally, 2-4 years of hands-on Linux system administration experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the System Administrator position is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the System Administrator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the System Administrator post will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR System Administrator position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the System Administrator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the System Administrator post at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the System Administrator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the System Administrator position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for the System Administrator role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration. Proficiency in shell scripting (Bash) and familiarity with Linux command-line tools are also essential.

faq.question: Q10. Where is JNCASR located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560064.
